text: On December 17 and 18, 2024, City Council adopted Item NY19.29, approving the installation of pedestrian crossovers at three right-turn channel locations at the northeast, northwest, and southeast corners of the intersection of Steeles Avenue East and Bayview Avenue, and pedestrian crossovers at two right-turn channel locations at the southeast and southwest corners of Steeles Avenue East and Leslie Street. These pedestrian crossovers aim to improve safety at these right-turn channels by making drivers more aware of the presence of pedestrians and reinforcing pedestrians' right-of-way to cross.
